35			return
36		}

40			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

23	// modelState represents the lifecycle state of a managed model process.
24	type modelState int
25	
26	const (
27		stateIdle      modelState = iota // not loaded or failed
28		stateLoading                     // llama-server starting up
29		stateLoaded                      // loaded and serving requests
30		stateUnloading                   // unloading: SIGTERM sent, waiting for exit
31	)
32	
33	func (s modelState) String() string {
34		switch s {
35		case stateIdle:
36			return "idle"
37		case stateLoading:
38			return "loading"
39		case stateLoaded:
40			return "loaded"
41		case stateUnloading:
42			return "unloading"
43		default:
44			return "unknown"
45		}
46	}
47	
48	type procState struct {
49		mu        sync.Mutex
50		modelName string
51		params    config.ModelParams
52		port      int
53		proc      *exec.Cmd
54		startedAt time.Time
55		restarts  int
56		isWarmup  bool
57	
58		// State machine. state and ready are always updated together under mu.
59		state   modelState
60		ready   chan struct{} // closed when loading completes (success or failure); nil when idle
61		loadErr error         // non-nil if the most recent load attempt failed
62	
63		// In-flight tracking and LRU.
64		inflight atomic.Int64
65		lastUsed time.Time
66	
67		// Per-model lifecycle control.
68		cancel context.CancelFunc
69		wg     sync.WaitGroup // Done when the supervisor goroutine exits
70	}
71	
72	// addInflight increments the in-flight counter and updates lastUsed.
73	// Returns the address, release function, and no error.
74	func (ps *procState) addInflight(port int) (addr string, release func(), err error) {
75		ps.inflight.Add(1)
76		ps.mu.Lock()
77		ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
78		ps.mu.Unlock()
79		return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port), func() { ps.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
80	}
81	
82	// Manager supervises llama-server child processes.
83	type Manager struct {
84		cfg        *config.Config
85		log        *slog.Logger
86		cmdBuilder func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd
87	
88		// healthTimeout overrides the 120s waitHealthy timeout. Zero means 120s.
89		// Set in tests to speed up failure scenarios.
90		healthTimeout time.Duration
91	
92		// vram is the optional VRAM tracker for admission control. nil = count-only.
93		vram *vram.Tracker
94	
95		// drainTimeout is the max time to wait for in-flight requests to complete
96		// before sending SIGTERM. Zero means 30s.
97		drainTimeout time.Duration
98	
99		mu      sync.RWMutex
100		procs   map[string]*procState
101		ctx     context.Context    // manager root context (detached from any HTTP request)
102		wg      sync.WaitGroup     // Done when all supervisors exit
103		cancel  context.CancelFunc // cancels m.ctx
104		eventCh chan monitor.ServerEvent
105	}
106	
107	// New creates a Manager. It does not start any processes; call Start.
108	func New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) *Manager {
109		m := new(Manager)
110		m.cfg = cfg
111		m.log = log
112		m.procs = make(map[string]*procState)
113		m.eventCh = make(chan monitor.ServerEvent, 256)
114		m.cmdBuilder = func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd {
115			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "llama-server", buildArgs(modelName, params)...)
116		}
117		return m
118	}
119	
120	// SetCmdBuilder replaces the default llama-server launcher. Used in tests to
121	// inject a fake process builder without starting real llama-server instances.
122	func (m *Manager) SetCmdBuilder(fn func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd) {
123		m.cmdBuilder = fn
124	}
125	
126	// SetVRAMTracker attaches a VRAM tracker for VRAM-aware admission control.
127	// When nil (default), only the max_models count limit is enforced.
128	func (m *Manager) SetVRAMTracker(t *vram.Tracker) { m.vram = t }
129	
130	// effectiveDrainTimeout returns the configured drain timeout or the default 30s.
131	func (m *Manager) effectiveDrainTimeout() time.Duration {
132		if m.drainTimeout > 0 {
133			return m.drainTimeout
134		}
135		return 30 * time.Second
136	}
137	
138	// drainAndCancel waits up to drainTimeout for in-flight requests to complete,
139	// then cancels the model's context to initiate SIGTERM. Must NOT hold m.mu.
140	func (m *Manager) drainAndCancel(ps *procState) {
141		deadline := time.Now().Add(m.effectiveDrainTimeout())
142		for ps.inflight.Load() > 0 {
143			remaining := time.Until(deadline)
144			if remaining <= 0 {
145				m.log.Warn("drain timeout exceeded, forcing shutdown", "model", ps.modelName)
146				break
147			}
148			sleep := 10 * time.Millisecond
149			if remaining < sleep {
150				sleep = remaining
151			}
152			time.Sleep(sleep)
153		}
154		ps.cancel()
155	}
156	
157	// Events returns a receive-only channel of structured events from all managed processes.
158	func (m *Manager) Events() <-chan monitor.ServerEvent {
159		return m.eventCh
160	}
161	
162	// Snapshot returns a point-in-time snapshot of all managed processes.
163	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
164		m.mu.RLock()
165		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
166	
167		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
168		for _, ps := range m.procs {
169			ps.mu.Lock()
170			pid := 0
171			if ps.proc != nil && ps.proc.Process != nil {
172				pid = ps.proc.Process.Pid
173			}
174			status := monitor.BackendStatus{
175				Name:      ps.modelName,
176				Model:     ps.modelName,
177				Port:      ps.port,
178				PID:       pid,
179				Loaded:    ps.state == stateLoaded,
180				Status:    ps.state.String(),
181				StartedAt: ps.startedAt,
182				Restarts:  ps.restarts,
183			}
184			ps.mu.Unlock()
185			result = append(result, status)
186		}
187		return result
188	}
189	
190	// RunningModels returns model names of all currently healthy processes.
191	func (m *Manager) RunningModels() []string {
192		m.mu.RLock()
193		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
194		var names []string
195		for name, ps := range m.procs {
196			ps.mu.Lock()
197			healthy := ps.state == stateLoaded
198			ps.mu.Unlock()
199			if healthy {
200				names = append(names, name)
201			}
202		}
203		return names
204	}
205	
206	// ListModels returns all known models in any state except idle.
207	func (m *Manager) ListModels() []monitor.ModelInfo {
208		m.mu.RLock()
209		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
210		result := make([]monitor.ModelInfo, 0, len(m.procs))
211		for _, ps := range m.procs {
212			ps.mu.Lock()
213			state := ps.state
214			name := ps.modelName
215			ps.mu.Unlock()
216			if state != stateIdle {
217				result = append(result, monitor.ModelInfo{ID: name, Status: state.String()})
218			}
219		}
220		return result
221	}
222	
223	// Start initialises the manager's root context. Warmup models are loaded
224	// through the gateway's admission path (Gateway.Warmup), not here.
225	func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
226		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
227		m.ctx = ctx
228		m.cancel = cancel
229		return nil
230	}
231	
232	// startSupervisor creates a procState and launches the supervisor goroutine.
233	// Must NOT hold m.mu.
234	func (m *Manager) startSupervisor(modelName string, params config.ModelParams, isWarmup bool) error {
235		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
236		ps := &procState{
237			modelName: modelName,
238			params:    params,
239			state:     stateLoading,
240			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
241			cancel:    modelCancel,
242			isWarmup:  isWarmup,
243		}
244	
245		m.mu.Lock()
246		m.procs[modelName] = ps
247		m.mu.Unlock()
248	
249		m.wg.Add(1)
250		ps.wg.Add(1)
251		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
252		return nil
253	}
254	
255	// Reload applies newCfg to the running manager. Models whose params changed are
256	// drained and restarted; models no longer matching any pattern are drained and
257	// removed; new warmup entries are started. Models with unchanged params keep
258	// serving without interruption.
259	//
260	// Global fields that require a process restart (e.g. listen address) are logged
261	// as warnings but not applied.
262	func (m *Manager) Reload(newCfg *config.Config) {
263		if m.cfg.Listen != newCfg.Listen {
264			m.log.Warn("listen address changed; requires restart to take effect",
265				"old", m.cfg.Listen, "new", newCfg.Listen)
266		}
267	
268		type drainOp struct {
269			name      string
270			ps        *procState
271			newParams config.ModelParams
272			restart   bool
273			isWarmup  bool
274		}
275	
276		newWarmupSet := make(map[string]bool, len(newCfg.Warmup))
277		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {
278			newWarmupSet[name] = true
279		}
280	
281		m.mu.Lock()
282		m.cfg = newCfg
283	
284		var ops []drainOp
285		for name, ps := range m.procs {
286			ps.mu.Lock()
287			state := ps.state
288			oldParams := ps.params
289			wasWarmup := ps.isWarmup
290			ps.mu.Unlock()
291	
292			if state != stateLoaded && state != stateLoading {
293				continue
294			}
295	
296			newParams, ok := newCfg.MatchModel(name)
297			if !ok {
298				m.log.Info("draining removed model", "model", name)
299				ps.mu.Lock()
300				ps.state = stateUnloading
301				ps.mu.Unlock()
302				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
303				continue
304			}
305	
306			if !oldParams.Equal(newParams) {
307				m.log.Info("reloading model", "model", name)
308				ps.mu.Lock()
309				ps.state = stateUnloading
310				ps.mu.Unlock()
311				ops = append(ops, drainOp{
312					name:      name,
313					ps:        ps,
314					newParams: newParams,
315					restart:   true,
316					isWarmup:  wasWarmup || newWarmupSet[name],
317				})
318				continue
319			}
320	
321			if wasWarmup && !newWarmupSet[name] {
322				m.log.Info("draining removed warmup model", "model", name)
323				ps.mu.Lock()
324				ps.state = stateUnloading
325				ps.mu.Unlock()
326				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
327			}
328		}
329		m.mu.Unlock()
330	
331		// Cancel all affected models simultaneously, then wait for each to exit.
332		// This runs outside m.mu to avoid deadlocking with the supervisor goroutine.
333		for i := range ops {
334			ops[i].ps.cancel()
335		}
336		for i := range ops {
337			ops[i].ps.wg.Wait()
338		}
339	
340		m.mu.Lock()
341		for i := range ops {
342			delete(m.procs, ops[i].name)
343		}
344		m.mu.Unlock()
345	
346		// Restart models whose params changed.
347		for _, op := range ops {
348			if op.restart {
349				if err := m.startSupervisor(op.name, op.newParams, op.isWarmup); err != nil {
350					m.log.Error("failed to restart model after reload", "model", op.name, "error", err)
351				}
352			}
353		}
354	
355		// Start new warmup models not currently in procs.
356		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {
357			m.mu.RLock()
358			_, exists := m.procs[name]
359			m.mu.RUnlock()
360			if exists {
361				continue
362			}
363			params, ok := newCfg.MatchModel(name)
364			if !ok {
365				continue
366			}
367			m.log.Info("starting new warmup model", "model", name)
368			if err := m.startSupervisor(name, params, true); err != nil {
369				m.log.Error("failed to start new warmup model", "model", name, "error", err)
370			}
371		}
372	}

412	// LoadOrGet returns a LoadTicket for the named model, loading it on demand if
413	// necessary. The ticket's Ready() channel receives the backend address when the
414	// model is healthy, or is closed on failure. Concurrent calls for the same
415	// unloaded model coalesce — one process starts and all waiters get the result.
416	//
417	// The caller must call ticket.Release() (typically via defer) when the proxied
418	// request completes to decrement the in-flight counter.
419	func (m *Manager) LoadOrGet(modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *LoadTicket {
420		ticket := newTicket()
421	
422		// Fast path: check under read lock to avoid goroutine overhead for
423		// the common already-loaded case.
424		m.mu.RLock()
425		ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]
426		m.mu.RUnlock()
427		if ok {
428			ps.mu.Lock()
429			state := ps.state
430			port := ps.port
431			ready := ps.ready
432			ps.mu.Unlock()
433	
434			switch state {
435			case stateLoaded:
436				addr, rel, _ := ps.addInflight(port)
437				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
438				return ticket
439			case stateLoading:
440				go func() {
441					<-ready
442					addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
443					if err != nil {
444						ticket.fail(err)
445					} else {
446						ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
447					}
448				}()
449				return ticket
450			case stateUnloading:
451				ticket.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: model %q", ErrModelDraining, modelName))
452				return ticket
453			}
454		}
455	
456		var estimate uint64
457		if m.vram != nil {
458			estimate = m.vram.EstimateForModel(modelName)
459		}
460		go m.startLoad(ticket, modelName, params, estimate)
461		return ticket
462	}

464	// startLoad is the slow path of LoadOrGet: acquires the write lock, evicts if
465	// needed, and either joins an in-progress load or starts a new supervisor.
466	func (m *Manager) startLoad(ticket *LoadTicket, modelName string, params config.ModelParams, estimate uint64) {
467		m.mu.Lock()
468	
469		// Re-check state under write lock; may have changed since fast-path check.
470		if ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
471			ps.mu.Lock()
472			state := ps.state
473			ready := ps.ready
474			port := ps.port
475			ps.mu.Unlock()
476	
477			switch state {
478			case stateLoaded:
479				m.mu.Unlock()
480				addr, rel, _ := ps.addInflight(port)
481				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
482				return
483			case stateLoading:
484				m.mu.Unlock()
485				<-ready
486				addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
487				if err != nil {
488					ticket.fail(err)
489				} else {
490					ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
491				}
492				return
493			case stateUnloading:
494				m.mu.Unlock()
495				ticket.fail(fmt.Errorf("%w: model %q", ErrModelDraining, modelName))
496				return
497			case stateIdle:
498				delete(m.procs, modelName)
499			}
500		}
501	
502		if err := m.evictIfNeeded(modelName, estimate); err != nil {
503			m.mu.Unlock()
504			ticket.fail(err)
505			return
506		}
507	
508		// evictIfNeeded releases and re-acquires m.mu; re-check for concurrent loads.
509		if ps2, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
510			ps2.mu.Lock()
511			state2 := ps2.state
512			ready2 := ps2.ready
513			port2 := ps2.port
514			ps2.mu.Unlock()
515			switch state2 {
516			case stateLoaded:
517				m.mu.Unlock()
518				addr, rel, _ := ps2.addInflight(port2)
519				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
520				return
521			case stateLoading:
522				m.mu.Unlock()
523				<-ready2
524				addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
525				if err != nil {
526					ticket.fail(err)
527				} else {
528					ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
529				}
530				return
531			}
532		}
533	
534		// Start a new supervisor.
535		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
536		ps := &procState{
537			modelName: modelName,
538			params:    params,
539			state:     stateLoading,
540			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
541			cancel:    modelCancel,
542			isWarmup:  false,
543		}
544		m.procs[modelName] = ps
545		ready := ps.ready
546		m.mu.Unlock()
547	
548		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
549			Time:    time.Now(),
550			Backend: modelName,
551			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
552			Message: "loading on demand",
553		})
554	
555		m.wg.Add(1)
556		ps.wg.Add(1)
557		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
558	
559		<-ready
560		addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
561		if err != nil {
562			ticket.fail(err)
563		} else {
564			ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
565		}
566	}

594	// evictIfNeeded evicts the minimum set of idle models needed to admit a new
595	// model, enforcing both the max_models count limit and the VRAM budget.
596	//
597	// Must be called with m.mu write-locked. It releases and re-acquires m.mu
598	// while draining evicted supervisors, so the caller must re-validate procs
599	// state after it returns.
600	func (m *Manager) evictIfNeeded(modelName string, estimate uint64) error {
601		type candidate struct {
602			name     string
603			ps       *procState
604			lastUsed time.Time
605			vramEst  uint64
606		}
607		var candidates []candidate
608		running := 0
609	
610		for name, ps := range m.procs {
611			ps.mu.Lock()
612			state := ps.state
613			lu := ps.lastUsed
614			ps.mu.Unlock()
615	
616			if state != stateIdle {
617				running++
618			}
619			if state == stateLoaded && ps.inflight.Load() == 0 {
620				vramEst := uint64(0)
621				if m.vram != nil {
622					vramEst = m.vram.EstimateForModel(name)
623				}
624				candidates = append(candidates, candidate{name: name, ps: ps, lastUsed: lu, vramEst: vramEst})
625			}
626		}
627	
628		needCountEvict := m.cfg.MaxModels > 0 && running >= m.cfg.MaxModels
629		needVRAMEvict := m.vram != nil && estimate > 0 && m.vram.FreeVRAM() < estimate
630	
631		if !needCountEvict && !needVRAMEvict {
632			return nil
633		}
634		if len(candidates) == 0 {
635			if needVRAMEvict && !needCountEvict {
636				return fmt.Errorf("insufficient VRAM for %q; all loaded models have in-flight requests", modelName)
637			}
638			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity (%d/%d models); all loaded models have in-flight requests", running, m.cfg.MaxModels)
639		}
640	
641		// Sort LRU: oldest first (evict least-recently-used first).
642		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
643			return candidates[i].lastUsed.Before(candidates[j].lastUsed)
644		})
645	
646		// Greedily select the minimum number of victims (LRU order) that satisfies
647		// both the count constraint and the VRAM budget.
648		var victims []candidate
649		countSatisfied := !needCountEvict
650		vramSatisfied := !needVRAMEvict
651		free := uint64(0)
652		if m.vram != nil {
653			free = m.vram.FreeVRAM()
654		}
655		vramFreed := uint64(0)
656	
657		for _, c := range candidates {
658			victims = append(victims, c)
659			running--
660			vramFreed += c.vramEst
661	
662			if !countSatisfied && running < m.cfg.MaxModels {
663				countSatisfied = true
664			}
665			if !vramSatisfied && free+vramFreed >= estimate {
666				vramSatisfied = true
667			}
668			if countSatisfied && vramSatisfied {
669				break
670			}
671		}
672	
673		if !countSatisfied || !vramSatisfied {
674			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity; cannot free enough resources for model %q", modelName)
675		}
676	
677		// Mark all victims as unloading and release their VRAM reservations before
678		// dropping the lock — new requests will be rejected immediately.
679		for i := range victims {
680			victims[i].ps.mu.Lock()
681			victims[i].ps.state = stateUnloading
682			victims[i].ps.mu.Unlock()
683			if m.vram != nil {
684				m.vram.Release(victims[i].name)
685			}
686			m.log.Info("evicting model (LRU)", "model", victims[i].name)
687			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
688				Time:    time.Now(),
689				Backend: victims[i].name,
690				Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
691				Message: "unloading (LRU eviction)",
692			})
693		}
694	
695		// Release the manager lock while draining all victims concurrently.
696		m.mu.Unlock()
697		for _, v := range victims {
698			m.drainAndCancel(v.ps)
699			v.ps.wg.Wait()
700		}
701		m.mu.Lock()
702		for _, v := range victims {
703			delete(m.procs, v.name)
704		}
705		return nil
706	}

724	// supervise is the per-model restart loop. It runs until ctx is cancelled
725	// or (for on-demand models) until the first load attempt fails or the process
726	// exits after becoming healthy.
727	func (m *Manager) supervise(ctx context.Context, modelName string) {
728		defer m.wg.Done()
729	
730		m.mu.RLock()
731		ps := m.procs[modelName]
732		m.mu.RUnlock()
733	
734		// Ensure state is idle and the ready channel is closed on exit (for any
735		// reason). This unblocks callers waiting in LoadOrGet and lets Loaded()
736		// return false after the supervisor exits.
737		defer func() {
738			ps.wg.Done()
739			ps.mu.Lock()
740			ready := ps.ready
741			ps.ready = nil
742			// Only preserve stateUnloading; evictIfNeeded owns that transition.
743			if ps.state != stateUnloading {
744				ps.state = stateIdle
745			}
746			ps.mu.Unlock()
747			if ready != nil {
748				close(ready)
749			}
750		}()
751	
752		const (
753			maxRetries  = 5
754			retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
755			backoff     = 2 * time.Second
756		)
757	
758		var (
759			attempts    int
760			windowStart = time.Now()
761			firstLoad   = true
762		)
763	
764		for {
765			select {
766			case <-ctx.Done():
767				return
768			default:
769			}
770	
771			if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
772				attempts = 0
773				windowStart = time.Now()
774			}
775			if attempts >= maxRetries {
776				m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "model", modelName)
777				return
778			}
779	
780			if attempts > 0 && ps.isWarmup {
781				// Before retrying a warmup model, create a fresh ready channel so
782				// new callers waiting in LoadOrGet see the correct loading state.
783				ps.mu.Lock()
784				ps.state = stateLoading
785				ps.loadErr = nil
786				ps.ready = make(chan struct{})
787				ps.mu.Unlock()
788	
789				m.log.Info("restarting model", "model", modelName, "attempt", attempts)
790				select {
791				case <-ctx.Done():
792					return
793				case <-time.After(backoff):
794				}
795			}
796	
797			attempts++
798	
799			ps.mu.Lock()
800			if !firstLoad {
801				ps.restarts++
802			}
803			ps.startedAt = time.Now()
804			params := ps.params
805			ps.mu.Unlock()
806	
807			cmd, parser, err := m.launch(ctx, modelName, params)
808			if err != nil {
809				m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "model", modelName, "error", err)
810				if !ps.isWarmup {
811					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
812					return
813				}
814				continue
815			}
816	
817			// Wait for llama-server to report its listening port via stdout.
818			var port int
819			select {
820			case port = <-parser.PortCh:
821			case <-ctx.Done():
822				cmd.Process.Kill()
823				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
824				return
825			case <-time.After(m.effectiveHealthTimeout()):
826				m.log.Error("timed out waiting for listening port", "model", modelName)
827				cmd.Process.Kill()
828				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
829				if !ps.isWarmup {
830					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for listening port"))
831					return
832				}
833				continue
834			}
835	
836			ps.mu.Lock()
837			ps.port = port
838			ps.proc = cmd
839			ps.mu.Unlock()
840	
841			loadStart := time.Now()
842			if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, m.effectiveHealthTimeout()); err != nil {
843				m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "model", modelName, "error", err)
844				cmd.Process.Kill()
845				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
846				ps.mu.Lock()
847				ps.proc = nil
848				ps.mu.Unlock()
849				if !ps.isWarmup {
850					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
851					return
852				}
853				continue
854			}
855	
856			loadDur := time.Since(loadStart)
857	
858			// Transition to healthy and signal all waiters by closing ready.
859			ps.mu.Lock()
860			ps.state = stateLoaded
861			if firstLoad {
862				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
863			}
864			ready := ps.ready
865			ps.ready = nil
866			ps.mu.Unlock()
867	
868			if ready != nil {
869				close(ready)
870			}
871			firstLoad = false
872	
873			if m.vram != nil {
874				if est := m.vram.EstimateForModel(modelName); est > 0 {
875					if !m.vram.Reserve(modelName, est) {
876						m.log.Warn("VRAM reservation failed after model load", "model", modelName)
877					}
878				}
879			}
880	
881			m.log.Info("model healthy", "model", modelName, "port", port, "load_duration", loadDur)
882			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
883				Time:       time.Now(),
884				Backend:    modelName,
885				Kind:       monitor.EventModelLoad,
886				DurationMs: float64(loadDur.Milliseconds()),
887				Message:    "loaded",
888			})
889	
890			exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
891			go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
892	
893			select {
894			case <-ctx.Done():
895				<-exitCh
896				return
897	
898			case exitErr := <-exitCh:
899				ps.mu.Lock()
900				ps.state = stateIdle
901				ps.proc = nil
902				ps.mu.Unlock()
903	
904				if ctx.Err() != nil {
905					return
906				}
907	
908				oomKilled := false
909				if exitErr != nil {
910					if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
911						// OOM killer sends SIGKILL — detect via WaitStatus.
912						if ws, ok := ee.Sys().(syscall.WaitStatus); ok && ws.Signal() == syscall.SIGKILL {
913							oomKilled = true
914							m.log.Error("process killed by SIGKILL (likely OOM)", "model", modelName)
915						} else {
916							m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
917						}
918					} else {
919						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "error", exitErr)
920					}
921				}
922	
923				if !ps.isWarmup {
924					// On-demand model crashed; remove and stop.
925					m.mu.Lock()
926					delete(m.procs, modelName)
927					m.mu.Unlock()
928					return
929				}
930	
931				// OOM: back off longer to let the system recover before reloading.
932				if oomKilled {
933					oomDelay := 30 * time.Second
934					m.log.Warn("delaying restart after OOM kill", "model", modelName, "delay", oomDelay)
935					select {
936					case <-ctx.Done():
937						return
938					case <-time.After(oomDelay):
939					}
940				}
941			}
942			// Warmup model: fall through to retry loop.
943		}
944	}

946	// failLoad signals a failed on-demand load to all waiters and cleans up.
947	func (m *Manager) failLoad(ps *procState, modelName string, err error) {
948		m.log.Error("model load failed", "model", modelName, "error", err)
949		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
950			Time:    time.Now(),
951			Backend: modelName,
952			Kind:    monitor.EventError,
953			Message: "load failed: " + err.Error(),
954		})
955	
956		ps.mu.Lock()
957		ps.loadErr = err
